final: SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL) AS fraction_of_total, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(c) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_major)) AS ratio_to_avg FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_major ORDER BY ratio_to_avg DESC LIMIT 10
